stratified_before.scope: Stratified finite samples on actual trimmed STEP. Statistics are per-face balanced, not area weighted. Source normals use unfiltered crease-separated fans; flat normals are reported separately. Not a Hausdorff, continuity, or self-intersection certificate.

stratified_after.scope: Stratified finite samples on actual trimmed STEP. Statistics are per-face balanced, not area weighted. Source normals use unfiltered crease-separated fans; flat normals are reported separately. Not a Hausdorff, continuity, or self-intersection certificate.

frozen_before.scope: Frozen source locations on actual STEP supports; failed or ambiguous identity is unverified. These correspondence measurements do not replace global distance or smoothness diagnostics.

frozen_after.scope: Frozen source locations on actual STEP supports; failed or ambiguous identity is unverified. These correspondence measurements do not replace global distance or smoothness diagnostics.

seams_baseline.scope: Actual shared-curve parameters on cached native polynomial supports; source dihedral is only a crease proxy. This sampled diagnostic does not certify G1/G2 or replace STEP validation.

seams_before_normal_repair.scope: Actual shared-curve parameters on cached native polynomial supports; source dihedral is only a crease proxy. This sampled diagnostic does not certify G1/G2 or replace STEP validation.

seams_after_normal_repair_and_cad_rollba.scope: Actual shared-curve parameters on cached native polynomial supports; source dihedral is only a crease proxy. This sampled diagnostic does not certify G1/G2 or replace STEP validation.

local_normal_repair.scope: Sampled normal cones and interior probes in selected source domains; actual trimmed STEP and CAD validation required.

compatible_prior_supports.scope: Reuse mesh-derived prior coefficients only after all current shared curves and source-domain probes pass unchanged geometric budgets. Full STEP and Creo checks still required.

cad_support_rollback.source: Actual Creo diagnostic spatial localization; no CAD geometry used as a fitting target.

boundary_measurement_equivalence: Boundary report directly measures the final fitted cache used for the assembled STEP. Seam aggregation uses the same protocol, but locations and counts change with the curves; these are not identical paired spatial samples.
